## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear description of what the problem is. Example: "I always have to manually build pagination responses and it's repetitive..."

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Include any proposed API surface, decorator names, or option keys.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've already tried.

## Why would this benefit other users?

Explain how this feature would help the broader community of `nestjs-api-forge` users.

Add any code samples, mockups, or examples that help illustrate the idea.
